text:
jordan: Quick Q — where's the saved search (or a pinned query) for EU logs filtered by org:acme, model:zenith-gen, route:/v1/generate*, status 5xx and kv_cache_miss=true? I need to triage a spike this morning.

anna: I don't think we have that exact one pinned in eu. We have an AP-SG savedsearch for zenith 5xx but it doesn't check kvcache. @sam can you share the snippet? :wave:

sam: sure — we have a query I use for hunting, not saved. paste below:

```
org:"acme" AND model:"zenith-gen" AND route:"/v1/generate*" AND region:"eu-west-1" AND status:[500 TO 599] AND kv_cache_miss:true
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500
```

sam: note: exclude healthchecks if you want fewer noisy items — add `AND route:!"/health"`

jordan: perfect. Can someone save/pin it under ops library? name suggestion: `eu-acme-zenith-5xx-kvmiss`

li: I can create that. Confirming: pin in eng-sre > saved searches > name `eu-acme-zenith-5xx-kvmiss`, description "5xx for zenith-gen in EU with kv cache misses (for oncall)"? Also add it to the oncall playbook? :white_check_mark:

jordan: yes please. Also add a dashboard link (p95 latency for same filter) if you can.

anna: dashboard -> Observability > Dashboards > "Route Health (per-model)" has a p95 panel you can scope with the saved search as a filter. quick link: https://console.redwood.com/orgs/acme/observability/dashboards/route-health?model=zenith-gen&region=eu-west-1

li: created and pinned: https://console.redwood.com/orgs/acme/logs/saved-searches/eu-acme-zenith-5xx-kvmiss
ops-bot: Saved search `eu-acme-zenith-5xx-kvmiss` created by li at 2438766890

mike: added link to oncall runbook, under "Investigate 5xx (gen routes)". Also added a short query snippet for quick copy in the runbook.

jordan: awesome, thank you all. One more tiny tweak — can we make the saved search exclude `status:502` for our known downstream flapper? (we still want others).

li: done — updated to `status:[500 TO 599] AND NOT status:502`. pinned version updated at 2438767650.

jordan: perfect. saving this thread for context. :pray:

anna: flagging to oncall: @mike FYI in case the spike reappears.

mike: got it, watching the dashboard. ping me if we need to mute a noisy route. :mag:

jordan: thanks everyone.
